cd /app/work && python3 targeted.py && cat > cov2.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, random, sys, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submission')
import gen as G, main as M
dec = collections.Counter(); stat = collections.Counter()
for it in range(600):
    rng = random.Random(31337 + it)
    doc = G.gen(rng)
    root = json.loads(json.dumps(doc), object_pairs_hook=M._hook_pairs, parse_float=M._reject_float, parse_constant=M._reject_constant)
    st = M.validate(root)
    out = M.replay(st)
    for p in out["packets"]: dec[p["decision"]] += 1
    for j in out["jobs"]: stat[j["status"]] += 1
print("decisions:", dict(dec))
print("statuses:", dict(stat))
PYEOF
python3 cov2.py
